QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_18

question.text: Minimum investment from every investor in a Cat III AIF is INR 1 crore. This minimum is NOT applicable to:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per the CTR footnote, Accredited Investors are EXEMPT from the INR 1 crore minimum investment requirement (Third Amendment Regulations 2021). Sponsor/IM must still meet continuing-interest thresholds (their own rule). Family trusts and FPIs are NOT in the exemption list. **The Trap:** Sponsor/IM (A) follow a separate continuing-interest rule. Family trusts (C) must meet the 1 cr floor. FPIs (D) have no special minimum-investment exemption under AIF Regs. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-B tests AI framework at distribution. XIX-C/D test the 1 cr floor across categories. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** For institutional-only Cat III launches, target exclusive Accredited Investor subscription — enables sub-1-cr ticket sizes, bypasses the 1,000-investor cap, AND permits larger LVF-AI tenure extensions.
